data.exact_reserve_text: The net loss ratio for the financial year improved to 88.9% (2018: 104.2%) driven by reserve releases in older years of account due to better than expected claims experience. However, increased claims provisions on the 2019 year of account offset these releases, driven by catastrophe events (Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi and Hurricane Dorian) and other attritional losses related to wind, storm and hail.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a modest gross prior-year reserve release of GBP 2.309m in 2019 (a ~9.17% release relative to opening gross claims reserves of GBP 25.176m), driven by better-than-expected claims experience on older years. These favorable prior-year developments were partially offset by strengthening on the 2019 underwriting year due to catastrophe activity (Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi and Hurricane Dorian) and other attritional wind/storm/hail losses. The release is reported at gross claim level in the technical provisions movement note; no LOB-specific prior-year amounts are disclosed.
